title: Create Tier creates the tier and stays on its page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type a name no other tier uses (for example Fleet Plus).
  4. Click Create Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the active tiers.

Step 2:

  • The new tier's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • The page stays open with the name as its title.
  • The Customers tab can be opened at once and offers Manage Customers.
  • A message reads "Fleet Plus created" with "It prices the same as the tier before it until you set its rules."
